name: com.agentsnailmail/mailbox
title: AgentSnailMail
description: A real San Francisco mailbox at 100 Pine St with API and MCP tools for AI agents.

tools.name: start_signup
tools.description: Start an AgentSnailMail signup for a named human owner. No API key is required. Required: owner (legal_name or name, email, phone; company optional), box_type (business or personal), term (six_month or month_to_month). Optional: scan_plan (pay_per_scan, pkg_1_day, pkg_2_4_day, pkg_5_10_day; default pay_per_scan), answering_service, additional_names, ticket_reply_copies, confirmation_settings, agent_name, intended_use. Returns signup_id, a one-time claim_token (store it; it is shown once), an informational price quote, status, and next. If the owner email is not verified yet, Cloudflare sends a verification email first (click 'Verify email address'), and once verified AgentSnailMail emails the Confirm link. Unverified signups expire after 7 days. Rate-limited per IP.

owner.description: Signer (the Operator). legal_name is required; name is accepted as an alias for legal_name. company is optional.

email.description: Owner email that will receive Cloudflare verification, then our Confirm email

scan_plan.description: Optional scan plan; defaults to pay_per_scan

answering_service.description: true if signing up for IO SF answering service. The $50 installation is waived once answering service starts, not on interest alone.

additional_names.description: Extra names beyond 1 company + 1 individual, $10/month each. Maximum 20.

ticket_reply_copies.description: Opt the owner in to email copies of staff ticket replies (default off)

confirmation_settings.description: Opt-in human approval flags. All default off.

tools.name: get_signup_status
tools.description: Check an AgentSnailMail signup. No API key is required. Required: signup_id and the claim_token returned by start_signup. Refreshes email verification and sends our Confirm link once the owner verifies with Cloudflare. Optional: resend (boolean) to re-trigger pending verification or Confirm email when cooldown allows. Returns status, next, and the informational quote. Does not return the claim token or any API key.

resend.description: Optional: resend pending verification or Confirm email (subject to cooldown)

tools.name: claim_signup
tools.description: Once the linked mailbox is active (we activate your mailbox for agent access after first payment), return the first API key one time only. No API key is required; signup_id and claim_token are. Before the mailbox is active, returns an error with the current status. Store the key; it is not shown again.
